full_prompt_en: A square romantic fantasy landscape painting shows a stone bridge spanning a deep, mist filled waterfall valley beneath a glowing peach and gold sky. Across the upper third, billowing clouds open around a bright area of low sunlight. Their warm edges turn amber and apricot, while the inner folds retain muted mauve and gray shadow. On the left, steep rock towers rise through haze, carrying small clusters of distant structures and pointed tree silhouettes. The peaks behind them soften into overlapping blue gray layers that lead toward the central gap. At middle height, a dark masonry bridge crosses from one side of the gorge to the other. Its largest arch frames a pale distant opening, and a smaller arch disappears partly into the mist at left. The bridge's long level top provides a calm horizontal line amid the vertical cliffs and falling water. On the right, a wooded rock wall rises close to the viewer, its rough surfaces cut by narrow white waterfalls. The water drops in broken bright streams, then vanishes into a thick white vapor that fills the lower valley. Dense dark foliage gathers at the lower corners and along the cliff edges, offering a near foreground frame around the lighter center. The valley floor remains mostly hidden; only a faint winding pale passage can be followed through the drifting mist. The light comes from the glowing sky beyond the bridge, gilding cloud rims and distant stone while leaving the nearest trees and rocks in deep green black shadow. Soft atmospheric transitions make the far mountains recede, whereas small crisp highlights make the right hand falls feel nearer. The painted surface has gentle brush texture and blended glazes, with detail concentrated along the bridge and rocky silhouettes. The overall composition draws the eye through a dark natural frame toward the sunlit arch, balancing grand vertical depth with an almost still, luminous atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形浪漫主义奇幻风景画描绘一座石桥横跨云雾弥漫、瀑布飞落的深谷，上方是发着光的桃金色天空。上部三分之一处，翻涌的云层在一片低处阳光周围裂开。云缘转为琥珀与杏色，内部褶皱仍保留低饱和的淡紫和灰影。左侧，陡峭的岩塔穿过雾气升起，承载远处零星建筑和尖细树木剪影。其后的山峰软化为层叠的蓝灰色，通向中央缺口。画面中部，一座深色砌石桥从峡谷一侧通到另一侧。最大的拱洞框住远方一处浅色开口，左边较小的拱洞部分没入雾中。桥面长而平直的顶线，在竖立峭壁与飞落流水之间提供安定的水平线。右侧，一面生有树木的岩壁贴近观者，粗糙表面被窄窄的白色瀑布划开。水流以断续的亮线落下，随即消失在填满下方山谷的浓白水汽中。浓密的深色树丛聚集在下方角落和崖缘，在较亮的中央周围形成近景框架。谷底大半隐没，只能在飘动的雾中循着一道淡淡的浅色曲折通道。光来自桥后发亮的天空，为云缘与远处石体镀上金色，而最近处的树木和岩石则落入深绿黑色阴影。柔和的大气过渡使远山后退，瀑布上的细小清晰亮部则让右侧显得更近。绘画表面有轻柔笔触和融合的罩染，细节集中在桥梁与岩石剪影处。整体构图让目光穿过深色自然框架，抵达被阳光照亮的拱洞，以宏大的竖向纵深平衡近乎静止的明亮氛围。
style_prompt_en: The landscape painting uses layered, softly blended color to create immense atmospheric depth. Dark, textured masses anchor the near edges, while successive forms lose contrast, detail, and saturation as they recede into luminous haze. Broad cloud shapes carry peach, amber, dusty violet, and cool gray in slow transitions; small bright rims sharpen only where the light breaks through. Deep green black and brown areas are punctured by narrow white highlights, so falling or reflective passages read as active without overwhelming the darker structure. Forms alternate between rugged brushworked edges nearby and dissolved contours in the distance. A strong horizontal crossing stabilizes steep vertical movements, and a lighter central opening draws the eye through enclosing shadow. Light appears low and partly screened, creating warm glow above and cool vapor below. The overall effect is grand, contemplative, and painterly, with dramatic scale held together by gentle tonal recession and selective luminous detail.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅风景画通过层层叠加、柔和融合的颜色营造巨大的大气纵深。深色而富肌理的色块锚定近处边缘，连续形体随着后退逐渐失去对比、细节与饱和度，消入发光的薄雾。宽大的云状形体以桃色、琥珀色、灰紫与冷灰作缓慢过渡，只有透光处的细小亮缘变得清晰。深绿黑与棕色区域被狭窄的白色亮部穿透，使流动或反光的部分保持活力，却不压倒深色结构。形体在近处粗粝的笔触边缘与远处消融的轮廓之间交替。一道强烈的水平穿越稳定陡峭的竖向动势，较亮的中央开口把目光从环绕的阴影中引向深处。光线低斜而部分受遮，令上方产生暖光，下方保留冷色水汽。整体效果宏大而沉思，戏剧性的尺度由柔和的明度退远与选择性发光细节维系。
theme_en: A stone bridge spanning a misty waterfall valley beneath a glowing sky
theme_zh: 发光天空下，一座石桥横跨瀑布与云雾笼罩的山谷
name: Christophe Vacher
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
